				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m168_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_manager_hit_rate value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_manager_hit_rate value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_object_state value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_attempt_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 168 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_difficulty value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_prescreen_pass_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_sponsor_observation_id value = var:zg361_pp_m167_observation_id }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_observation_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_sample_pending value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_sample_settled value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_omitted_qualified value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_difficulty value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_omitted_qualified value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_risk_avoidance_debt value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m168_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m168_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m168_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m168_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m168_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m168_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m168_manager_hit_rate
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m168_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m168_manager_hit_rate } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m168_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m168_receipt_active = 1 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m168_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }

	}
